surface_mechanism_description: During the precursor pulse, the substrate was exposed to TBTDET. These MO molecules formed a monolayer on the substrate in a self-limiting manner by chemisorbing at appropriate surface sites. During the plasma pulse, highly reactive species such as hydrogen radicals and protons were generated in the gas phase, which chemically transformed the chemisorbed monolayer from the precursor pulse into a monolayer of tantalum carbonitride.
